title: The multi-stage build that ships everything
prompt: This two-stage Dockerfile was meant to keep TypeScript and dev dependencies out of production. The image is barely smaller than before and the scanner still reports CVEs in test tooling. Select the line that defeats the purpose of the second stage.
hints: Look at what the runtime stage copies from the build stage.
The build stage's `/app` contains `src/`, `dist/` and a `node_modules` with every dev dependency.
explanation:
Line 12 copies the build stage's entire `/app` into the runtime image, so `src/`, dev dependencies and anything else the context contained all ship. Add a production-only dependency stage and copy named paths:

```dockerfile
FROM node:24-slim AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev

FROM node:24-slim AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
```
